# waroom_service_label (Resource)

> **DNM**: doc-preview workflow test. This line must not be merged.

Manages a Waroom service label. Labels are used to categorize and organize items within a Waroom service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "waroom_service_label" "example" {
  service_name = "my-service"
  name         = "production"
  color        = "ff5733" # Red color in hex format (without #)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) The color of the label in hex format without the `#` prefix (e.g., `ff5733` for red, `008BD1` for blue, `00FF00` for green). Must be a valid 6-character hexadecimal color code.
- `name` (String) The display name of the label. This must be unique within the service.
- `service_name` (String) The name of the Waroom service to which the label belongs. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Label ID. This is an alias for `uuid` and is provided for convenience.
- `uuid` (String) The unique identifier (UUID) of the label. This is automatically generated by Waroom.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Service labels can be imported by specifying the service name and label UUID separated by a comma
# Format: service_name,uuid
terraform import waroom_service_label.example my-service,123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
```
